patch_resolves_note: The fixed line adds the missing `dist_from_out_buf_start == 0` rejection to the non-wrapping back-reference guard. In the fixed original run the PoC remains clean and only the guard event executes, with no downstream back-reference copy or Adler32 scan event.

root_cause_criterion.description: In the non-wrapping back-reference guard, dist_from_out_buf_start must be positive before the copy is allowed. When it is 0, the copy would source bytes from an unwritten output prefix.
root_cause_criterion.fix_mechanism: Reject the zero-output case in the line-501 non-wrapping guard before pSrc is formed.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original reaches backref_copy with dist_from_out_buf_start=0, so the required predicate dist_from_out_buf_start > 0 is violated. The fixed original is guarded at the same event, and the adjacent valid_backref_after_two_output_bytes case executes backref_copy with dist_from_out_buf_start=2 on the fixed binary, giving the required genuine witness.

nodes.description: The Adler32 scan reads more bytes than are initialized in the produced output prefix.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records adler32_scan.buf_len=32 > adler32_scan.initialized_prefix_len=0.

nodes.description: The regular back-reference copy uses pSrc equal to pOut_buf_start, so the copy reads from the output buffer base itself.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records backref_copy.copy_src == backref_copy.output_base == 0x70f000000000.

edges.description: The same dist_from_out_buf_start value computed at the non-wrapping guard becomes the prior_output_len used by the regular back-reference copy.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records nonwrapping_guard.dist_from_out_buf_start == backref_copy.prior_output_len == 0.

edges.description: The output buffer base involved in the regular back-reference copy is the same base pointer later scanned by the Adler32 sink.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records backref_copy.output_base == adler32_scan.buf_base == 0x70f000000000.
